name: Varra
source:
A mage woman sent to the brothel where Celicia is held captive as a guard.

She is a subordinate and lover of Garchik, the commander of the Royal Guard. (Garchik is Celicia's superior officer.)
) She has won Zogem's trust with her colorful tricks.

She is skilled in secret arts and can manipulate the growth of Celicia's body at will. She cooperates with Zogem's humiliating training of Celicia.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/selicia/index.html]official site[/url]]
